text.offer: I'm feeling a little sick. I don't suppose you could go to the Widow Qesino, at the inn in Jasper, and ask her for a bowl of her special chicken soup, could you? I'd be most grateful.
text.complete: Thanks so much, I feel better already just from smelling this delicious soup! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.

steps.objective: Ask the Widow Qesino for chicken soup

steps.brief: Oh, of course, dear! Here's a bowl of my special soup for Solomon. Wish him well for me.
